name: Hatsumomiji
about: Hatsumomiji is a brewery in central Shunan, Yamaguchi, a short walk from Tokuyama Station. The Harada family has run it since 1819, and the current head is the twelfth generation.

As demand fell, it stopped brewing in 1985 and for some years sold sake made by other breweries under its own name. Brewing later resumed in an air-conditioned brewery that can work all year, and seasonal releases are now central to what it does.
Its main label, Harada, uses rice such as Yamadanishiki and the Yamaguchi variety Saito no Shizuku. Some releases use spring water from the Kano district of northern Shunan.
